newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Mines kill Bangladesh elephants near Burma border.
newsitem.headline: Mines kill Bangladesh elephants near Burma border.

text.p: Two wild elephants were killed by mines, believed to have been laid by Burmese troops, at Naikhyangchhari, 45 km (27 miles) from Cox's Bazar resort town, Bangladesh police said on Saturday.
Villagers found the dead elephants near the Burmese border on Saturday, police told Reuters.
Mines have killed at least six Bangladeshis, mostly wood-cutters, in forests along the border this month, they said.
Security sources said a Burmese border force called Nasaka had planted hundreds of mines along the frontier to prevent cross-border insurgents.
